question: How can I benchmark Ask Fern's accuracy against my documentation?
ground_truth: Fern provides an evaluation system that generates test questions from your documentation, runs them through both Ask Fern and competitor AI search solutions, then evaluates each answer against the original documentation for accuracy. You'll receive detailed performance metrics and comparative analysis. However, this feature is currently not generally available and requires contacting support@buildwithfern.com to get started.
